label: Threshold at high drain bias
subgoals: Take the threshold measured at low drain bias
Subtract the DIBL coefficient times the drain-voltage increase
Express the result as the saturation threshold

label: Extracting the DIBL coefficient
subgoals: Measure threshold at low and at full drain bias with one definition
Divide the threshold drop by the drain-voltage difference
Repeat across lengths to capture the length dependence

label: The leakage cost of DIBL
subgoals: Multiply the DIBL coefficient by the drain-voltage change
Divide by the subthreshold swing to get decades
Raise ten to that power for the off-current factor
